name: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders
summary: Kul Tiras forces keep their coastal positions in Durotar, and Admiral Proudmoore's Orders lay out their plans. The documents were written before Daelin Proudmoore fell at Theramore and describe a campaign against the Horde.

sections.title: A Legacy of Hatred
sections.body: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders show that the Kul Tiras forces at Tiragarde Keep still mean to fight. Lieutenant Benedict's garrison holds the papers, which detail long-term maneuvers and fortifications against the Horde. The plans show that Daelin Proudmoore's offensive in Durotar was an organized campaign, built to continue after his death. For the Horde, the documents reveal Kul Tiras operations and possible reinforcements threatening its borders.

sections.title: Delivery to Grommash Hold
sections.body: Horde scouts send the recovered orders to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. They deliver them to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber, where the plans support Nazgrel's warning that humans cannot be trusted and remain an active danger. Horde leaders now have reason to prepare for more attacks along the coast.

faq.answer: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders are military directives Daelin Proudmoore drew up before he fell at Theramore. They direct the remaining Kul Tiras soldiers in Durotar to fortify coastal positions and wage war against the Horde.

aliases: where do i find the orders
faq.answer: The orders were recovered at Tiragarde Keep in Durotar, during the struggle against Kul Tiras forces near the southeastern coast.

faq.q: Who needs to see these orders?
aliases: who do i turn this into
faq.answer: Nazgrel needs to see the orders. He counsels Warchief Thrall inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.

faq.q: Why are Kul Tiras soldiers still fighting in Durotar?
faq.answer: Kul Tiras soldiers remain in Durotar because Lieutenant Benedict and others stayed devoted to Admiral Proudmoore's mission to exterminate the orcs. His orders gave the garrison plans to keep harassing Durotar without his direct oversight.

angles.text: For the Horde, these documents support those who argued that human truces would not last. They show Kul Tiras forces intended a war of extermination from the moment they landed.
As a Darkspear troll, these orders show that the human presence along the coast where your people make their home remains an immediate danger.
